description: The Coco Data Hub, in the README's step order: the strategic supply chain analysis, the acquisitions' systems inventory, the component-to-platform mapping and supply chain lineage, the data field naming standard (its own batch), the systems' data layer, the strategic digital products, the solution design, the software development governance program, setting up the data sharing hub, receiving the OpenLineage events, the digital product subscriptions, Egeria's operational data store, and the security team's operational data store. Includes the folder's notebooks, so it is not idempotent; setting-up-the-data-hub.ipynb needs the optional Unity Catalog runtime. The OpenLineage topic is normally catalogued by the OpenLineage Events batch: receiving-open-lineage-events.ipynb skips the cataloguing when the topic exists and refreshes the OpenLineageKafkaListener.
